yt_description:
🤯 Ever wondered how sorting algorithms work under the hood? Dive into the mesmerizing world of Odd-Even Sort! This intuitive algorithm sorts arrays by repeatedly stepping through the list, comparing adjacent elements and swapping them if they are in the wrong order. We'll visualize its elegant dance, showing you step-by-step how it brings chaos to order. Perfect for students, developers, and anyone curious about the beauty of algorithms! 🚀
